{{Quote|''Resolute'' command to Gold Leader. We are standing by.|Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Downfall" />}}
'''''Resolute'' command''' was a was a command unit that was stationed in the of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Resolute/Legends|Resolute's]]'' [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. During the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was part of the command structure and contacted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was the [[Gold Leader/Legends|leader]] of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the battle against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the battle. During the battle, one [[Unidentified clone trooper (Resolute)/Legends|clone trooper]] served alongside Tano as a member of the ''Resolute'' command.<ref name="Downfall" />
